summary.text: Timothy Hazelo is a Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 10-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Dave Paul (D).
A U.S. Navy veteran who served from 1987 to 2007, he was the Republican nominee for Washington's 2nd Congressional District in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Timothy Hazelo was born in Pontiac, Michigan, and served in the U.S. Navy from 1987 to 2007, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Hazelo said he joined the Navy in 1987 and came to Washington state with the Navy in 1995.

Hazelo ran for U.S. House in Washington's 2nd District in 2020, advancing from the August 4 primary in second place and losing the general election to incumbent Rick Larsen, 63.1 percent to 36.7 percent.
In 2026 he finished second in the August 4 primary for District 10-Position 2 with 22.0 percent of the vote, behind Paul, who received 58.7 percent.

In his 2020 survey, Hazelo listed the economy and growth, homelessness and mental health, military readiness, veterans and first responders, healthcare and drug costs, education and skills training, immigration reform and term limits among his core policy issues.
